title: 2024 · Paqua Monna · 远航选段

source.title: HKDSE English Language 2024 Paper 3 Part A — Task 2
source.notes: 来自你已有的 2024 真题：Part A PDF 第 5 页（印刷页 6）、Script PDF 第 1 页左半（P.5/15）、MS+CP PDF 第 8 页（印刷页 146）。本选段只练第 13–20 题，后续第 21–26 题不在录音内。原卷第 19、20 题的船形图已改成宽度、长度文字题；保留原题号。字幕按原稿校正，拼读中的连字符和空格统一显示；13 个词暂按整句定位。中文解析为教学说明，非官方译文。

source.timingReview: Verified source wording; machine-aligned word times are not fully human-audited. Missing/low-confidence times remain null.

instructions: Listen to a lecture from Professor Elsa Larssen, an expert in human migration, on a famous expedition. Complete the information in the spaces below. The first one has been provided as an example. You now have 30 seconds to study the task. At the end of the task, you will have one minute to tidy up your answers.
example: Name of lecture series: Museum Experiences.

sentences.speaker: Prof. Larssen
sentences.text: Hello, and welcome to today's ‘Museum Experiences’ lecture in which I'm going to talk about the Paqua Monna expedition.

sentences.speaker: Prof. Larssen
sentences.text: For those of you who are taking notes, let me spell that out for you.

sentences.speaker: Prof. Larssen
sentences.text: That's two words — P-a-q-u-a, and M-o-double-n-a.

sentences.speaker: Prof. Larssen
sentences.text: This is a very interesting example of how one man set out to explore one of the great mysteries of human migration.

sentences.speaker: Prof. Larssen
sentences.text: That is, how Polynesia, a huge area of islands in the Pacific Ocean, came to be home to people with similar language and customs.

sentences.speaker: Prof. Larssen
sentences.text: At that time, most experts thought that people from Polynesia had originally come from Southeast Asia.

sentences.speaker: Prof. Larssen
sentences.text: However, one Danish explorer who wasn't convinced by this idea decided to take action.

sentences.speaker: Prof. Larssen
sentences.text: His name was Lars Jenson and it's his story I want to talk about today.

sentences.speaker: Prof. Larssen
sentences.text: Jenson was sure that the Polynesian islands were settled by people travelling from South America.

sentences.speaker: Prof. Larssen
sentences.text: And his theory was that people from South America travelled to Polynesia in boats and sailed from South America across the Pacific Ocean to Polynesia.

sentences.speaker: Prof. Larssen
sentences.text: So, he decided to build a wooden boat and prove his theory by sailing the boat from South America himself.

sentences.speaker: Prof. Larssen
sentences.text: He set about the task by thinking carefully about the materials he needed to build his boat and planning the route he'd take.

sentences.speaker: Prof. Larssen
sentences.text: He also had to think about how many people he'd need on his team.

sentences.speaker: Prof. Larssen
sentences.text: He realised that his boat needed to be light and strong.

sentences.speaker: Prof. Larssen
sentences.text: So, he used a native South American wood which was known for its lightness and strength.

sentences.speaker: Prof. Larssen
sentences.text: His wooden boat measured fourteen metres long and five metres wide, that's fourteen in length by five in width, and it had a big sail to catch the wind.

questions.prompt: Topic of the lecture: The ___ Expedition.
questions.explanation: 留意逐字母拼读：Paqua Monna，第二个词中间是 double n。两个词都要写出。

questions.prompt: People in Polynesia share similar — item 1: ___
questions.explanation: 这里问共同之处：语言和习俗。第 14、15 题可互换顺序，同一个项目只算一次；录音说 language，评分参考写 languages。

questions.prompt: People in Polynesia share similar — item 2: ___
questions.explanation: 这里问共同之处：语言和习俗。第 14、15 题可互换顺序，同一个项目只算一次；录音说 language，评分参考写 languages。

answers: C. From South America to Polynesia
questions.explanation: 先听到 Southeast Asia 是当时多数专家的观点；题目问 Jenson 的远航路线，要抓住 from South America 和 to Polynesia。
options: A. From Polynesia to Southeast Asia
B. From Polynesia to South America
C. From South America to Polynesia
D. From South America to Southeast Asia

questions.prompt: Qualities of the wood Jenson used for his boat — item 1: ___
questions.explanation: 木材要轻而且结实。第 17、18 题可互换顺序，两项不能重复；后面的 lightness 和 strength 是同一信息的名词表达。
